## BC Farm Cash Receipt (FCR) Detailed

This R Markdown document is an annotated set of scripts to combine multiple Statistics Canada (STC) tables related to FCR into one clean file saved in the team's SharePoint data library.

For more information, visit the ReadMe file at <https://github.com/bcgov/nr-af-data-analysis/tree/main/BC%20FCR%20Detailed>. Contact [alstats\@gov.bc.ca](mailto:alstats@gov.bc.ca) for any questions.

There are 6 tables to be loaded from STC. The main FCR table with aggregated data is [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501) and the other 5 provide more detailed FCR breakdown:

- [Table 32-10-0365-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210036501) Area, production and farm gate value of marketed vegetables

- [Table 32-10-0364-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210036401) Area, production and farm gate value of marketed fruits

- [Table 32-10-0456-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045601) Production and value of greenhouse fruits and vegetables

- [Table 32-10-0246-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210024601) Production and sale of greenhouse flowers and plants

- [Table 32-10-0452-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045201) Estimates of field-grown cut flowers area, production and sales

- [Table: 32-10-0356-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/cv.action?pid=3210035601) Area, production and sales of mushrooms

This script generally loads the above tables into the environment based on the specified date cut-off then, using a specified set of vectors, filters the data frame (or DF) and cleans it Specific steps are:

A.  Set-up and load library

B.  Load detailed Livestock FCR and calculate "Other livestock and livestock products" from total livestock in main FCR table as residual

C.  Load mushrooms and detailed field vegetable FCR breakdown to calculate "Other field vegetables" from total field vegetable in main FCR table as residual

D.  Load detailed fruit FCR breakdown and calculate "Other fresh fruits" from total fruits in main FCR table as residual

E.  Load detailed greenhouse (GH) fruits & veg and calculate "Other GH veg" from total GH veg in main FCR table as residual. Note that Strawberries are excluded from total GH veg and considered a GH fruit

F.  Load floriculture field and subtract from total floriculture to calculate GH floriculture.

G.  Load sod from Annual Greenhouse Survey table and fill in suppressed data.

H.  Load the total floriculture, nursery and sod form the main FCR table as well as floriculture and append the sod table to calculate nursery total. Load GH floriculture and nursery, subtract GH floriculture to calculate GH nursery then subtract GH nursery from total nursery to get field nursery estimate.

I.  Load the main FCR table for other commodities that do not have further breakdown and calculate "other crops" as the difference between total crop FCR less all other breakdowns from **AllFiledVegFCR, AllFruitsFCR, AllGHFruitVegFCR, AllOtherCropsFCR** and save into **AllCropsFCR**

J.  Load Direct Payments into **AllDirectPaymentsFCR** DF

K.  Hard code the FCR reference table for crosswalk

L.  Append all tables (**AllCropsFCR, AllLivestockFCR and AllDirectPaymentsFCR**) then left-join with the crosswalk

M.  Write .csv and save into data library

## A. Set-up and load library

In addition to loading necessary packages from the library, this chunk of code also specifies the date cut-off by which the data will be filtered by.

```{r Set-up}

# Load library
library(pacman)
p_load(cansim,
       dplyr,
       data.table,
       tidyr,
       lubridate,
       tictoc,
       splitstackshape,
       stringr,
       zoo,
       tibble)

# Specify date cut-off
date_cutoff <- year("2014-01-01")


```

## B. Livestock FCR

Unlike other commodity groups, all detailed livestock data can be found in the main FCR table. However, the sum of those breakdowns exceed total livestock FCR so a new "Other livestock and livestock products" will need to be calculated as residual.

```{r Livestock}

tic()

# Load the Livestock table from the main FCR table 
LivestockFCR <- get_cansim("32-10-0045") 

# Clean the LivestockFCR dataframe
LivestockFCR <- LivestockFCR %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Type of cash receipts` = as.character(`Type of cash receipts`),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename Type of cash receipts to Commodity
  rename(
    Commodity = `Type of cash receipts`,
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep selected livestock
  filter(
    Commodity %in% c(
      "Cattle",
      "Calves",
      "Hogs",
      "Sheep",
      "Lambs",
      "Unprocessed milk from bovine",
      "Chickens for meat",
      "Turkeys for meat",
      "Eggs in shell",
      "Natural honey (except pollen)",
      "Hatcheries - chicks and poults",
      "Total livestock and livestock product receipts"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Replace "and" with "&"
  mutate(Commodity = str_replace_all(Commodity, "Total livestock and livestock product receipts", "Total livestock & livestock product")) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Value)

# Pivot wide
AllLivestockFCR <- LivestockFCR %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, GEO),
    names_from = Commodity,
    values_from = Value,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Calculate Other livestock & livestock products
AllLivestockFCR <- AllLivestockFCR %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)),
         `Other livestock & livestock products` =
           `Total livestock & livestock product` -
           `Cattle` -
           `Calves` -
           `Hogs` -
           `Sheep` -
           `Lambs` -
           `Unprocessed milk from bovine` -
           `Chickens for meat` -
           `Turkeys for meat` -
           `Eggs in shell` -
           `Natural honey (except pollen)` -
           `Hatcheries - chicks and poults`
  ) %>%
  
  # drop column
  select(-`Total livestock & livestock product`) 

# Pivot long and replace 0 with null
AllLivestockFCR <- AllLivestockFCR %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !c(Date, GEO),
    names_to = "Commodity",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Value = na_if(Value, 0)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value))


# Drop DFs no longer used
rm(LivestockFCR)

toc()
```

## C. Field Vegetable FCR

1.  Load the mushroom estimates ([Table: 32-10-0356-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/cv.action?pid=3210035601) in DF called **MushroomFCR**) noting that the "Fresh vegetables - field" total from [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501) includes mushroom receipts.

2.  After loading detailed field vegetable FCR breakdown, load the total field veg from the main FCR table and and calculate "Other field vegetables". The calculation is done by appending **MushroomFCR** and detailed field veg estimates ([Table 32-10-0456-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045601) in DF called **FieldVegFCR**) with total field veg estimate ([Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501) in DF called **FCR_TotalFieldVeg**) to create a new DF called **AllFieldVeg**.

3.  The DF **AllFieldVeg** is then pivoted wider and "Other field vegetables" is calculated by subtracting the sum of broken down field vegetable estimates from the total field vegetable estimate.

4.  The total field vegetable estimate column is then dropped to avoid double counting and the entire **AllFieldVeg** DF is pivoted longer for appending with other DFs to create the full detailed FCR DF.

5.  Fresh cabbage should equal Fresh regular cabbage + Fresh Chinese cabbage + Fresh kale but it is not always the case. For now, only Fresh cabbage is loaded but additional work to calculate "other cabbage" could be done. Similarly, Fresh radishes should equal Fresh radishes (except Asian radishes) + Fresh Asian radishes and other radishes need to be calculated for future iterations of this code to show that breakdown.

```{r FieldVeg}
tic()

# Load the Mushroom table
MushroomFCR <- get_cansim("32-10-0356")

# Clean the MushroomFCR dataframe
MushroomFCR <- MushroomFCR %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep total area harvested
  filter(
    Estimates == "Value (fresh and processed), total"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Value
  rename(
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Value)

# Add commodity variable 
MushroomFCR$Commodity <- "Fresh & processed mushrooms"

# Linear interpolation of suppressed mushroom data
MushroomFCR <- MushroomFCR %>%
  arrange(Date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Value = zoo::na.approx(Value, x = Date, na.rm = FALSE
                                   , maxgap = 2))

# Load the Field Vegetable table
FieldVegFCR <- get_cansim("32-10-0365") 

# Clean the FieldVegFCR dataframe
FieldVegFCR <- FieldVegFCR %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Estimates and Commodity to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Commodity = as.character(Commodity),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area planted in hectares
  filter(
    Estimates == "Farm gate value (dollars)"
  ) %>%
  
  # Exclude these commodities because they are further breakdowns that can be suppressed
  filter(
    !Commodity %in% c(
      "Total fresh vegetables",
      "Fresh Chinese cabbage",
      "Fresh regular cabbage",
      "Fresh kale",
      "Fresh Asian radishes",
      "Fresh radishes (except Asian radishes)"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Fresh cucumbers" ~ "Fresh cucumbers and fresh gherkins (all varieties)",
      Commodity == "Other fresh vegetables" ~ "Other field vegetables",
      Commodity == "Fresh radishes " ~ "Fresh radishes",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Value
  rename(
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Value)

# Pull FieldVeg total from the main FCR table
FCR_TotalFieldVeg <- get_cansim("32-10-0045") 

# Clean the FCR_TotalFieldVeg dataframe
FCR_TotalFieldVeg <- FCR_TotalFieldVeg %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Type of cash receipts` = as.character(`Type of cash receipts`),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename Type of cash receipts to Commodity
  rename(
    Commodity = `Type of cash receipts`,
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only field vegetable which includes mushrooms
  filter(
    Commodity == "Fresh vegetables - field"
    ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Value)

# Append both Field Veg tables + mushrooms to total
AllFieldVegFCR <- bind_rows(
  FCR_TotalFieldVeg,
  FieldVegFCR,
  MushroomFCR)

# Pivot wide
AllFieldVegFCR <- AllFieldVegFCR %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, GEO),
    names_from = Commodity,
    values_from = Value,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Calculate Other field vegetable
AllFieldVegFCR <- AllFieldVegFCR %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)),
         `Other field vegetables` =
           `Fresh vegetables - field` -
           `Fresh asparagus` -
           `Fresh green and wax beans` -
           `Fresh beets` -
           `Fresh broccoli` -
           `Fresh Brussels sprouts` -
           `Fresh cabbage` -
           `Fresh carrots` -
           `Fresh cauliflowers` -
           `Fresh celery` -
           `Fresh sweet corn` -
           `Fresh cucumbers and fresh gherkins (all varieties)` -
           `Fresh garlic` -
           `Fresh leeks` -
           `Fresh lettuce` -
           `Fresh dry onions` -
           `Fresh parsley` -
           `Other fresh fine herbs` -
           `Fresh parsnips` -
           `Fresh green peas` -
           `Fresh pumpkins` -
           `Fresh French shallots and green onions` -
           `Fresh spinach` -
           `Fresh squash and zucchini` -
           `Fresh eggplants (except Chinese eggplants)` -           
           `Fresh tomatoes` -
           `Fresh peppers` -
           `Fresh radishes` -
           `Fresh rhubarb` -
           `Fresh rutabagas and turnips` -
           `Fresh watermelons` -
           `Other fresh melons` -
           `Fresh sweet potatoes` -
           `Fresh & processed mushrooms`
  ) %>%
  select(-`Fresh vegetables - field`) # drop column

# Pivot long and replace 0 with null
AllFieldVegFCR <- AllFieldVegFCR %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !c(Date, GEO),
    names_to = "Commodity",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
mutate(Value = na_if(Value, 0)) %>%
filter(!is.na(Value))

# Drop DFs no longer used
rm(FCR_TotalFieldVeg, FieldVegFCR, MushroomFCR)

(toc)
```

## D. Fruits FCR

1.  After loading detailed fruits FCR breakdown into DF called **FruitsFCR** from [Table 32-10-0364-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210036401), load the total fresh fruits, apples, blueberries, strawberries, grapes and cranberries from the main FCR table ([Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501)) into **FCR_TotalFruits** DF by appending both DFs to each other in a new DF called **AllFruitsFCR**.That DF is then pivoted wider to calculate "Other fresh fruits" by subtracting all broken down fruit FCR estimates from the total fruit FCR.

2.  Fresh apples, blueberries, cranberries, grapes and strawberries come from the main FCR table ([Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501)) rather than [Table 32-10-0364-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210036401) because the latter is released earlier and the former are re-estimates from STC.

3.  Note that currants, haskaps and fresh sour cherries are not loaded because it causes the "Other fresh fruits" to be negative for certain years and are counted as "other fresh fruits".

4.  Breakdown between highbush vs. lowbush blueberries and labrusca vs. vinifera grapes not yet loaded and residual will need to be calculated from total blueberries and total grapes

Similar to field vegetables, the total fruits column is dropped and then **AllFRuitsFCR** is pivoted long for appending with other detailed FCR tables.

```{r Fruits}

tic()

# Load the detailed Fruit table
FruitsFCR <- get_cansim("32-10-0364") 

# Clean the FruitsFCR dataframe
FruitsFCR <- FruitsFCR %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Estimates, farm area and Commodity to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Commodity = as.character(Commodity),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates)
    ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area planted in hectares
  filter(
    Estimates == "Farm gate value"
  ) %>%
  
  # Exclude these commodities
  filter(
    !Commodity %in% c(
      "Total fresh fruit",
      "Fresh apples",
      "Fresh blueberries",
      "Fresh cranberries",
      "Fresh grapes",
      "Fresh strawberries",
      "Fresh highbush blueberries",
      "Fresh lowbush blueberries",
      "Fresh Labrusca grapes",
      "Fresh vinifera, fresh French hybrid grapes",
      "Other fresh fruit, n.e.c."
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Value
  rename(
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Value)


# Pull Fruits total from the main FCR table
FCR_TotalFruits <- get_cansim("32-10-0045")

# Clean the FCR_TotalFruits dataframe
FCR_TotalFruits <- FCR_TotalFruits %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Type of cash receipts` = as.character(`Type of cash receipts`),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename Type of cash receipts to Commodity
  rename(
    Commodity = `Type of cash receipts`,
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep selected fruits
  filter(
    Commodity %in% c(
      "Total fresh fruit",
      "Fresh apples",
      "Fresh blueberries",
      "Fresh cranberries",
      "Fresh strawberries",
      "Fresh grapes")
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Value)


# Append both Fruit tables
AllFruitsFCR <- bind_rows(
  FCR_TotalFruits,
  FruitsFCR)

# Pivot wide
AllFruitsFCR <- AllFruitsFCR %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, GEO),
    names_from = Commodity,
    values_from = Value,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Calculate Other fresh fruits
AllFruitsFCR <- AllFruitsFCR %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)),
         `Other fresh fruits` =
           `Total fresh fruit` -
           `Fresh apples` -
           `Fresh blueberries` -
           `Fresh cranberries` -
           `Fresh strawberries` -
           `Fresh grapes` -
           `Fresh apricots` -
           `Fresh sweet cherries` -
           `Fresh nectarines` -
           `Fresh peaches` -
           `Fresh pears` -
           `Fresh plums and prune plums` -
           `Fresh raspberries` -
           `Fresh saskatoon berries`-
           `Fresh blackberries`
  ) %>%
  select(-`Total fresh fruit`) # drop column

# Pivot long and replace 0 with null
AllFruitsFCR <- AllFruitsFCR %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !c(Date, GEO),
    names_to = "Commodity",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Value = na_if(Value, 0)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value))


# Drop DFs no longer used
rm(FCR_TotalFruits, FruitsFCR)

toc()
```

## E. Greenhouse Fruits & Vegetables FCR

1.  The only greenhouse fruit with detailed FCR estimate is strawberries, or vector v1271897860 so the first part of the chunk of code below builds the AllGHFruitFCR table using that vector.

2.  The next part is to load the detailed GH vegetable breakdown from [Table 32-10-0456-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045601) and we replace "fresh" with GH to distinguish from field-grown vegetables. The total GH vegetables is pulled from main FCR table, [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501), then appended with the detailed GH vegetables. Other GH vegetables is then calculated as the difference between total GH vegetables from the main FCR table, [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501) and the sum of GH vegetable breakdown from [Table 32-10-0456-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045601).

```{r GHFruitVeg}

tic()

# Load the GH Fruit & Veg table
GHFruitVegFCR <- get_cansim("32-10-0456") 

# Clean the GHFruitVegArea dataframe
GHFruitVegFCR <- GHFruitVegFCR %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Commodity and production value to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Commodity = as.character(Commodity),
    `Production and value` = as.character(`Production and value`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    `Production and value` == "Farm gate value"
  ) %>%

  # Exclude these commodities
  filter(
    !Commodity %in% c(
      "Other fresh fruits or vegetables")
  ) %>%


  # Rename val_norm to Value
  rename(
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Value)

# Replace fresh with GH
GHFruitVegFCR$Commodity <- gsub("Fresh", "GH", GHFruitVegFCR$Commodity)

# Pull GH Fruit & Veg total from the main FCR table
FCR_TotalGHVeg <- get_cansim("32-10-0045") 

# Clean the FCR_TotalGHVeg dataframe
FCR_TotalGHVeg <- FCR_TotalGHVeg %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and and Type of cash receipt to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Type of cash receipts` = as.character(`Type of cash receipts`),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename Type of cash receipts to Commodity
  rename(
    Commodity = `Type of cash receipts`,
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only field vegetable which includes mushrooms
  filter(
    Commodity == "Fresh vegetables - greenhouse"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Value)

# Append both GH FV tables
AllGHFruitVegFCR <- bind_rows(
  FCR_TotalGHVeg,
  GHFruitVegFCR)

# Pivot wide
AllGHFruitVegFCR <- AllGHFruitVegFCR %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, GEO),
    names_from = Commodity,
    values_from = Value,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Calculate Other GH fruits and veg
AllGHFruitVegFCR <- AllGHFruitVegFCR %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)),
         `Other GH fruits or vegetables` =
           `Fresh vegetables - greenhouse` -
           `GH tomatoes` -
           `GH cucumbers` -
           `GH lettuce` -
           `GH peppers` -
           `GH eggplants (except Chinese eggplants)` -
           `GH Chinese vegetables` -
           `GH fine herbs` -
           `GH green and wax beans` -
           `GH microgreens and shoots` -
           `GH sprouts`
  ) %>%
  select(-`Fresh vegetables - greenhouse`) # drop column

# Pivot long and replace 0 with null
AllGHFruitVegFCR <- AllGHFruitVegFCR %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !c(Date, GEO),
    names_to = "Commodity",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Value = na_if(Value, 0)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value))


# Drop DFs no longer used
rm(FCR_TotalGHVeg, GHFruitVegFCR)

toc()
```

## F. Floriculture FCR

1.  Load and clean floriculture field FCR from annual greenhouse survey [Table 32-10-0452-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045201)) into the DF called **FloricultureFieldFCR**.

2.  Backcast to 2015 using DF called **Backcast2015** and append to **FloricultureFieldFCR**

3.  Then, load Floriculture products (except flower seeds) from the main FCR table, [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501), into DF called FCR_Floriculture and append/bind rows with **FloricultureFieldFCR** into a DF called **AllFloricultureFCR**.

4.  Calculate GH floriculture as the difference between total floriculture products (except flower seeds) and field grown flowers.

```{r Floriculture}

# Load the Floriculture Field from the Annual Greenhouse Survey
FloricultureFieldFCR <- get_cansim("32-10-0452")

# Clean the FloricultureFieldFCR dataframe
FloricultureFieldFCR <- FloricultureFieldFCR %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Area and GEO to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    GEO = as.character(GEO),
    `Area, production, and sales` = as.character(`Area, production, and sales`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest 10 years
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only total gross sales
  filter(
    `Area, production, and sales` == "Total gross sales"
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Value
  rename(
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Value)

# Add commodity variable
FloricultureFieldFCR <- FloricultureFieldFCR %>%
  mutate(
    Commodity = "Field-grown flowers"
  )

# Fit linear trend using 2016-2025
fit <- lm(
  Value ~ Date,
  data = FloricultureFieldFCR,
  subset = Date >= 2016 & Date <= 2025
)

# Backcast the 2015 value
Backcast2015 <- data.frame(
  Date = 2015,
  GEO = "British Columbia",
  Value = as.numeric(
    predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(Date = 2015))
  ),
  Commodity = "Field-grown flowers"
)

# Add the backcasted 2015 observation
FloricultureFieldFCR <- FloricultureFieldFCR %>%
  bind_rows(Backcast2015) %>%
  arrange(Date)

# Remove backcast and fit
rm(Backcast2015, fit)

# Load the Floriculture data from the main FCR table 
FCR_Floriculture <- get_cansim("32-10-0045") 

# Clean the FCR_Floriculture dataframe
FCR_Floriculture <- FCR_Floriculture %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Type of cash receipts` = as.character(`Type of cash receipts`),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename Type of cash receipts to Commodity
  rename(
    Commodity = `Type of cash receipts`,
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only total floriculture
  filter(
    Commodity == "Floriculture products (except flower seeds)"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Value)

# Append  Floriculture tables
AllFloricultureFCR <- bind_rows(
  FCR_Floriculture,
  FloricultureFieldFCR)

# Pivot wide
AllFloricultureFCR <- AllFloricultureFCR %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, GEO),
    names_from = Commodity,
    values_from = Value,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Calculate GH floriculture products
AllFloricultureFCR <- AllFloricultureFCR %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)),
         `GH floriculture` =
           `Floriculture products (except flower seeds)` -
           `Field-grown flowers`
  ) %>%
  select(-`Floriculture products (except flower seeds)`) # drop column

# Pivot long and replace 0 with null
AllFloricultureFCR <- AllFloricultureFCR %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !c(Date, GEO),
    names_to = "Commodity",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Value = na_if(Value, 0)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value))

# Drop DFs no longer used
rm(FCR_Floriculture, FloricultureFieldFCR)
```

## G. Sod FCR

1.  Starting by loading sodFCR from the Annual Greenhouse Survey, Table: 32-10-0034-01 into the DF called **AllSodFCR**.

2.  Filter only for "Total sod sales" and "Gross revenue from sod grown"

3.  Both numbers are historically the same with one or the other being suppressed so we filter out any missing values and group by Date to fill in missing values

4.  Drop the "Type" column and replace with "Commodity" which is sod

```{r Sod}

# Load Sod FCR from Annual Greenhouse Survey
AllSodFCR <- get_cansim("32-10-0034-01")

# Clean the GHFruitVegArea dataframe
AllSodFCR <- AllSodFCR %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year and production value to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Area sales and resales` = as.character(`Area sales and resales`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep selected types of data
  filter(
    `Area sales and resales` %in% c(
      "Total sod sales",
      "Gross revenue from sod grown")
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Value
  rename(
    Value = val_norm,
    Type = `Area sales and resales`
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only Total sod sales and Gross revenue from sod grown
  filter(
    Type %in% c(
      "Total sod sales",
      "Gross revenue from sod grown"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Group observations by year and geography
  group_by(Date, GEO) %>%
  
  # Remove rows where the value is missing
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  
  # Prioritize Total sod sales when both estimates have values
  arrange(
    Date,
    desc(Type == "Total sod sales")
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only one observation per year
  slice(1) %>%
  
  # Remove grouping
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Value)

# Add commodity variable 
AllSodFCR$Commodity <- "Sod"
```

## H. Nursery FCR

1.  The DF **FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery** is loaded from [Table 32-10-0246-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210024601) and grouped by summing total value to a DF called **FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery** then assigned commodity called "GH Floriculture & Nursery".

2.  Create a new DF called **GHFloricultureFCR** by filtering **AllFloricultureFCR** for only GH Floriculture.

3.  Load FCR for GH floriculture and nursery into DF called **FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery** from

4.  Bind rows/append DF **FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery** and **GHFloricultureFCR** into a new DF called **FCR_GHNursery**, pivot wide then calculate GH floriculture from Floriculture products (except flowers and seeds) less Field-grown cut flowers. In other words:

    GH floriculture = Total floriculture - Field-grown floriculture

5.  Bind rows/append DF **GHFloricultureFCR** with DF **FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery** and pivot wide to a new DF called **FCR_GHNursery** to calculate GH Nursery from GH floriculure & nursery less GH Floriculture or in other words:

    GH Nursery = GH Floriculture & Nursery - GH Floriculture

6.  Append All Nursery (DF called **AllNurseryFCR**) with GH nursery (DF called **FCR_GHNursery**), pivot wide and calculate field nursery (column called **Field Nursery**) as difference between all nusery less GH nursery. Pivot the entire DF long into **AllNurseryFCR**

```{r Nursery}

tic()

# Load the main FCR table for floriculture, nursery and sod 
FCR_FNS <- get_cansim("32-10-0045") 

# Clean the FCR_FNS dataframe
FCR_FNS <- FCR_FNS %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Type of cash receipts` = as.character(`Type of cash receipts`),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename Type of cash receipts to Commodity
  rename(
    Commodity = `Type of cash receipts`,
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep selected commodities
  filter(
    Commodity %in% c(
      "Floriculture and nursery products, and sod",
      "Floriculture products (except flower seeds)")
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Value)


# Append Sod with FCR_FNS
FCR_FNS <- bind_rows(
  FCR_FNS,
  AllSodFCR)

# Pivot wide
FCR_FNS <- FCR_FNS %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, GEO),
    names_from = Commodity,
    values_from = Value,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Calculate Total Nursery then pivot longer
AllNurseryFCR <- FCR_FNS %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)),
         `Nursery products (except tree and shrub seeds)` =
           `Floriculture and nursery products, and sod` -
           `Floriculture products (except flower seeds)` -
           `Sod`
  ) %>%
  
  # drop columns
  select(-c(`Floriculture and nursery products, and sod`,`Floriculture products (except flower seeds)`, `Sod`)) %>%
  
  # Pivot longer
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !c(Date, GEO),
    names_to = "Commodity",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# Load the GH Nursery table
FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery <- get_cansim("32-10-0246")

# Clean the FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery dataframe
FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery <- FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Output = as.character(Output),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename Value
  rename(
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only Sales
  filter(
    Output == "Sales"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Value)

# Sum and group FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery
FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery <- FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery %>%
  group_by(GEO, Date) %>%
  summarise(Value = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Create commodity column
FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery$Commodity = "GH Floriculture & Nursery"

# Filter AllFloricultureFCR for only GH floriculture
GHFloricultureFCR <- AllFloricultureFCR 
GHFloricultureFCR <- GHFloricultureFCR %>%
  filter(Commodity == "GH floriculture")

# Append GH Floriculture & Nursery with GH Floriculture
FCR_GHNursery <- bind_rows(
  FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery,
  GHFloricultureFCR)

# Pivot wide
FCR_GHNursery <- FCR_GHNursery %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, GEO),
    names_from = Commodity,
    values_from = Value,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  
  # Calculate GH Nursery
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)), 
         `GH Nursery` =
           `GH Floriculture & Nursery` -
           `GH floriculture`
         ) %>%
  
  # Drop column
  select(-c(`GH Floriculture & Nursery`, `GH floriculture`)
         ) %>% 
  
  # Pivot longer
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !c(Date, GEO),
    names_to = "Commodity",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# Append All Nursery with GH nursery to calculate field nursery
AllNurseryFCR <- bind_rows(
  AllNurseryFCR,
  FCR_GHNursery
)

# Pivot wide and calculate field nursery
AllNurseryFCR <- AllNurseryFCR %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, GEO),
    names_from = Commodity,
    values_from = Value,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  
  # Calculate field Nursery
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)), 
           `Field Nursery` =
             `Nursery products (except tree and shrub seeds)` -
             `GH Nursery`) %>%
    select(-c(`Nursery products (except tree and shrub seeds)`)
           ) %>%
  
  # drop column
    pivot_longer(
      cols = !c(Date, GEO),
      names_to = "Commodity",
      values_to = "Value"
    )

# Drop DFs no longer used
rm(FCR_FNS, FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery, FCR_GHNursery, GHFloricultureFCR)

toc()
```

## I. Other Crops FCR

This chunk of code pulls the remaining commodities from the main FCR table, [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501), into a DF called AllOtherCropsFCR. After cleaning, it is appended/row bind with all other crop DFs (**AllFiledVegFCR, AllFruitsFCR, AllGHFruitFCR, AllGHVegFCR, AllOtherCropsFCR**) into the DF called **AllCropsFCR**.

Other crops is calculated as the difference between Total crop receipts and all other crop breakdowns and saved into **AllCropsFCR**\$Other crops.

Note that deferred grain receipts are added rather than subtracted because its a negative number.

```{r Other Crops FCR}

# Start timer
tic()

# Load the main FCR table for all other commodities without further breakdown
AllOtherCropsFCR <- get_cansim("32-10-0045") 

# Clean the AllOtherCropsFCR dataframe
AllOtherCropsFCR <- AllOtherCropsFCR %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Type of cash receipts to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Type of cash receipts` = as.character(`Type of cash receipts`),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename Type of cash receipts to Commodity
  rename(
    Commodity = `Type of cash receipts`,
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep selected commodities
  filter(
    Commodity %in% c(
      "Total crop receipts",
      "Cannabis seeds, vegetative plants and flowering tops (including leaves)",
      "Fresh potatoes",
      "Christmas trees",
      "Wheat (except durum wheat)",
      "Oats",
      "Barley",
      "Deferred grain receipts",
      "Liquidation of deferred grain receipts",
      "Rye",
      "Flaxseed",
      "Canola (including rapeseed)",
      "Sunflower seeds",
      "Dry peas",
      "Forage seeds and grass seeds",
      "Hay",
      "Forest products",
      "Ginseng root for medicinal use")
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Value)

# Append All tables
AllCropsFCR <- bind_rows(
  AllOtherCropsFCR,
  AllFieldVegFCR,
  AllFruitsFCR,
  AllGHFruitVegFCR,
  AllFloricultureFCR,
  AllNurseryFCR,
  AllSodFCR)

# Pivot wide
AllCropsFCR <- AllCropsFCR %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, GEO),
    names_from = Commodity,
    values_from = Value,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Calculate All other crops FCR
AllCropsFCR <- AllCropsFCR %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)),
         `Other crops` =
           `Total crop receipts` -
           `Wheat (except durum wheat)` -
           `Oats` -
           `Barley` - 
           `Deferred grain receipts` -
           `Liquidation of deferred grain receipts` -
           `Rye` -
           `Flaxseed` -
           `Canola (including rapeseed)` -
           `Cannabis seeds, vegetative plants and flowering tops (including leaves)` -       
           `Fresh potatoes` -
           `Sunflower seeds` -
           `Dry peas` -
           `Forage seeds and grass seeds` -
           `Hay` -
           `Forest products` -
           `Christmas trees` -
           `Ginseng root for medicinal use` -
           `Fresh asparagus` -
           `Fresh green and wax beans` -
           `Fresh beets` -
           `Fresh broccoli` -
           `Fresh Brussels sprouts` -
           `Fresh cabbage` -
           `Fresh carrots` -
           `Fresh cauliflowers` -
           `Fresh celery` -
           `Fresh sweet corn` -
           `Fresh cucumbers and fresh gherkins (all varieties)` -
           `Fresh garlic` -
           `Fresh leeks` -
           `Fresh lettuce` -
           `Fresh dry onions` -
           `Fresh parsley` -
           `Other fresh fine herbs` -
           `Fresh parsnips` -
           `Fresh green peas` -
           `Fresh pumpkins` -
           `Fresh French shallots and green onions` -
           `Fresh spinach` -
           `Fresh squash and zucchini` -
           `Fresh eggplants (except Chinese eggplants)` -           
           `Fresh tomatoes` -
           `Fresh peppers` -
           `Fresh radishes` -
           `Fresh rhubarb` -
           `Fresh rutabagas and turnips` -
           `Fresh watermelons` -
           `Other fresh melons` -
           `Fresh sweet potatoes` -
           `Fresh & processed mushrooms` -
           `Other field vegetables` -  
           `Fresh apples` -
           `Fresh blueberries` -
           `Fresh cranberries` -
           `Fresh strawberries` -
           `Fresh grapes` -
           `Fresh apricots` -
           `Fresh sweet cherries` -
           `Fresh nectarines` -
           `Fresh peaches` -
           `Fresh pears` -
           `Fresh plums and prune plums` -
           `Fresh raspberries` -
           `Fresh saskatoon berries`-
           `Fresh blackberries`-
           `Other fresh fruits` -
           `GH strawberries` -

  ) %>%

# Pivot long and replace 0 with null
AllCropsFCR <- AllCropsFCR %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !c(Date, GEO),

  ) %>%

  filter(!is.na(Value))

rm(AllOtherCropsFCR,

toc()
```

Separately, the code below pulls all direct payments and breakdown from the main FCR table.

```{r Direct Payments FCR}

# Start timer

# Clean the AllDirectPaymentsFCR dataframe
AllDirectPaymentsFCR <- AllDirectPaymentsFCR %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Type of cash receipts to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Type of cash receipts` = as.character(`Type of cash receipts`),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename Type of cash receipts to Commodity
  rename(
    Commodity = `Type of cash receipts`,
    Value = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep selected commodities
  filter(
    Commodity %in% c(
      "Crop insurance payments",
      "AgriInvest",
      "Agri-Stability",
      "Provincial stabilization payments",
      "Other payments")
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Value)

toc()
```

```{r Crosswalk}
  "Livestock", "Red meat", "Lambs",
  "Livestock", "Red meat", "Sheep",
  "Livestock", "Supply-managed", "Chickens for meat",
  "Livestock", "Supply-managed", "Eggs in shell",
  "Livestock", "Supply-managed", "Hatcheries - chicks and poults",
  "Livestock", "Supply-managed", "Unprocessed milk from bovine",
  "Livestock", "Supply-managed", "Turkeys for meat"
)
```

## L. Append All Tables and Join Crosswalk

Append AllCropsFCR, AllLIvestockFCR and AllDirectPaymentsFCR into a DF called All_FCR_Detailed.

```{r FCRDetailed}

# Append All tables
All_FCR_Detailed <- bind_rows(
  AllCropsFCR,
  AllLivestockFCR,
  AllDirectPaymentsFCR)

# left join with reference table
All_FCR_Detailed <- All_FCR_Detailed %>%
  left_join(Commodity_Crosswalk, by = "Commodity")

```

## M. Write .csv and save into data library

As of August 2026, SITS cannot yet directly connect to a SharePoint URL to access the shared Unpublished Data library. The interim workaround is to sync that library to the user's Desktop and change the URL manually. Remember to replace "\\" with "/" and note that the timeout settings is 10 mins because the zip file is large and the default timeout of 1 min is insufficient to download and unzip the file.

Until BC Gov admins grant access, SharePoint files cannot easily be pulled using the **M365** R package. The temporary workaround is to sync the Unpublished Data Library with each user's desktop which needs to be updated in the code:

```         
"C:/Users/[replace with IDIR]/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data"
```

```{r Write}

# Set working directory
setwd("C:/Users/lebautis/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data")


# Write the csv file

fwrite(All_FCR_Detailed, "C:/Users/lebautis/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data/BC_FCR_Detailed.csv")

```
